title: Escrow Services in the Digital Era
publication: Escrow Services in the Digital Era

summary: Traces escrow from conventional transactional safeguards to software, cloud, data and business-continuity protections. It also considers how smart-contract triggers might support defined release conditions within a software-escrow arrangement.
